backlogged.summary: The new 절대 regex /절대(로)?(?=\s|$)(?!\s*경로)/ also exempts '절대로 경로…' (e.g. '절대로 경로를 바꾸지 않는다'), which is a real universal negation and not the technical term '절대 경로'. Consider exempting only '절대' + optional whitespace + '경로', not '절대로'.
lib/commands/run.mjs production code reads HARNESS_TEST_SLEEP_OFFSET_FILE and test/stress.mjs reads STRESS_TEST_CHILD_NODE_OPTIONS as test-only seams; a stray env value would change behaviour.
Nothing asserts that test/f21-sleep.test.mjs does not read lib/commands/run.mjs (AC-1 second clause holds today only because the file is mentioned only in a comment).
lib/stress.mjs is test-support code shipped under lib/.
